scope: Metadata mapping, strictly bounded nested slots and local preview contract only; not a website editor or shadcn runtime.

entries.title: Curated Registry metadata to block schema adapter / Registry 元数据白名单映射
features: Three original curated fixture identifiers map to existing V0.39 typed blocks
Unexpected external sources and unknown props fail closed
Unreviewed external items are inspect-only, never code imports
entries.limitations: Fixture-only metadata adapter; not shadcn registry-item.json implementation, vendor source installer, remote fetch or code licensing engine.

entries.title: Constrained nested slot document tree / 受限层级 Slot 文档
features: Root Section with bounded Section/Stack slot typing
At most depth three, unique parent ownership and 12 total nodes
Immutable insert/reparent and typed prop updates with validation
entries.limitations: Only simple fixture section/stack hierarchy; no true browser nesting gestures, arbitrary components, collaboration or nested page output.

entries.title: Local preview and confirmed editor command plan / 编辑命令预览确认
features: Read-only preview for insert/move/edit, no mutation before confirmation
Explicit confirmation with current revision/source snapshot check
Recompute preview and detect tampering, return local-only revision update
entries.limitations: No authentic approvals, signing, cryptographic digest, server authorization, remote writing, persistent revision store or Agent execution.
